label.label: Part
label.note: What the part is: a cell's row and column, a point's x, a roll-up member.

level.label: Level
level.note: A roll-up's node: the check's own level, or the member's verdict as the producer judged it.

verdict.label: Verdict
verdict.note: A gate matrix cell's verdict (pass, warn, fail, not_run).

value.label: Value
value.note: A cell's number, or a point's y.

part.label: Kind
part.note: cell (a matrix's), point (a series'), node (a roll-up's tree).

check.label: Check id
check.note: The checks row the part belongs to (its id).
